name: The Rip-Princess Cliché
storyline: Princess Peach has been ripped from her castle and taken to the lair of Bowser! Oh no, how cliché is that?!
summary:
Brought to you by a community composed of SMBX members, Team Rip makes a new experience of Redigit's "The Princess Cliche" that adds in fun SMBX2 features!
Journey the islands of this world and get the stars to stop Bowser on Vista Hill!
